judgment.label: incorrect
judgment.reason: Reference states 87% of restructuring liability is employee liabilities; candidate gives breakdown (81 of 93 = ~87%) but misattributes nature primarily to Russia-Ukraine conflict and Bemis integration, while evidence shows Q2 FY2023 (Dec 31, 2022) activities primarily Russia-Ukraine and Bemis was substantially completed end FY2022, not 'continued integration'. Also question asks nature & purpose as of Q2 FY2023 close; candidate's narrative mixes explanation but overstates Bemis as continued. Substantive answer partially agrees but materially mischaracterizes purpose/nature.
